description.mn: Ajmal Evoke Gold: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан модлог үнэр (EDP). Зүрхний ноот: цахилдаг, хув, герань.
description.en: Ajmal's Evoke Gold For Him is a masculine Woody Aromatic scent that debuted in 2018. Its opening notes are Neroli and Pepper, while its middle notes are a combination of Orris Root, Amber, and Geranium. To complete the fragrance, its base is composed of Cedar and Patchouli.
